EmailTemplate.description: Introducing the enrollment coach and congratulating on admission.
EmailTemplate.name: Enrollment Coach Admit: Call Contact
EmailTemplate.subject: Congratulations on your admission to Arizona State University!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
My name is {!User.FirstName}. I wanted to send you a personal note of congratulations on your admission to the {!Opportunity.Location__c} campus. You can call me anytime at XXX-XXX-XXXX to ask questions and talk about the experience you'll have at ASU.
I'm here for you, and I'll be in touch to see how you're doing throughout the rest of your college search process. I look forward to connecting soon.
{!User.FirstName} Enrollment Coach Admission Services
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
